$comment: Model tiers. Source-tree agents ship aliases; installed agents get a resolved ID written by scripts/resolve-models.mjs.

fast.why: High-volume, low-judgment work: classification and surface-level change detection.

medium.why: Reading code well enough to adjudicate claims against it.

strong.why: The reconciliation step resolves contradictions between agents and sets final tiers.

notes: Aliases, not full model IDs. An alias follows the recommended version for the provider and updates over time; a pinned ID goes stale silently and, worse, resolves differently per provider.

Recorded in each run's state.json for reproducibility: alias_requested, resolved_model, and claude_code_version. A subagent cannot reliably report its own resolved model, so it is resolved before dispatch.
If a tier is unavailable, the run degrades and records downgraded: true rather than failing.
